evidence: Severe blur covers the entire image, leaving only broad shapes while removing the sign lettering and almost all door detail.
Dense colored noise covers the sky and sea, reducing fine cloud and wave detail even though the sun, horizon, and main cloud shapes remain clear.
Strong blur smears the patterned box, tissues, and table edges, while visible grain further reduces fine surface detail.
Both language blocks remain sharp and readable, although fine colored grain is visible across the sign and surrounding wall.
The dome, windows, and stonework remain inspectable, but visible grain across the sky and buildings reduces the clarity of finer architectural detail.
Strong blur and coarse grain smear object edges, fabric detail, and package text, with repeated light traces showing substantial motion blur.
Stonework, tree bark, and foliage retain clear detail, with slight colored fringes around some branches against the bright sky.
Intense colored noise dominates the whole image and masks much of the sea texture and fine cloud detail, although the sun and horizon remain identifiable.
Fine branch outlines and cloud structure remain clear against a smooth sky, without meaningful visible blur, noise, or exposure damage.
Low exposure, blur, and visible grain obscure the bottle label and surface detail, leaving the bottle shape recognizable but its text unreadable.
